key.name: language-area-enabled
key.description: Keep the input method indicator in its own area, next to the tray icons on the side that looks towards the rest of the panel

key.name: language-area-role
key.description: Which panel indicator plays the language area: auto takes the panel item of the input method (kimpanel) when it is there and falls back to the keyboard indicator of the shell, keyboard and kimpanel pick one of the two

key.name: panel-background-mode
key.description: auto follows the color and the transparency of the panel bar, custom paints the tray area and the hidden icons panel with the color and the transparency set here

key.name: panel-background-color
key.description: Color the tray area and the hidden icons panel are painted with, also used when the panel bar does not report a color of its own

key.name: panel-background-opacity
key.description: Transparency of the tray background in percent, 100 being opaque

key.name: tray-icon-spacing
key.description: Space the tray icons, the language area and the fold button keep on their left and right side in pixel, 0 packs them together without any space

key.name: tray-pos
key.description: Set where the Icon tray should appear in Gnome tray

key.name: tray-order
key.description: Set where the Icon tray should appear among other trays

key.name: hidden-icons
key.description: Indicators that are collected in the floating panel next to the panel bar, instead of the tray area

key.name: hidden-legacy-icons
key.description: Window classes of legacy X11 tray icons that are never shown, neither in the tray area nor in the hidden icons panel. An application whose own tray icon is replaced by one of its own (an SNI icon, for instance) is listed here. Takes effect for icons that appear after the change, and hides the ones already shown.

key.name: icon-order
key.description: Order the tray icons are shown in, as indicator ids: the icons of the tray area first, then the ones of the hidden icons panel

key.name: known-icons
key.description: Tray icons seen by the extension, as (id, name) pairs

key.name: custom-icons
key.description: Replace any icons with custom icons from themes
